in_sanskrit.name: कृष्ण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who attracts all beings towards him by his divine love and grace. The one who is dark-complexioned or all-black. The one who is the source of all pleasure and joy.

in_hindi.name: कृष्ण
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is desirable and attractive to all. The one who is the source of all pleasures and desires.

in_tamil.name: கிருஷ்ண
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is dark in complexion and is the source of all joy and happiness. The one who is the lord of the universe and protects his devotees.

in_telugu.name: కృష్ణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the source of all pleasures and desires. The one who is the god of gods and the lord of the universe. The one who is dark-complexioned and all-attractive.

in_marathi.name: Krishay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krishay is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Krishna' meaning 'Black'. In Hindu mythology, Krishna is a god known for his mischievous pranks and divine love. As a protector, he is also called 'Vishnu' and 'Krishna Arjuna'.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Krishay একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Krishay is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Krishna' meaning 'Black'.
